verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly from left to right (small can, then the headline with a two-line subline, then a dominant CTA), but it drops the SOLSTICE wordmark and the NEW FLAVOR badge, and the subline is tiny. B keeps the badge and logo but squeezes the logo into a cramped spot between the badge and the headline, drops the can, and wraps the subcopy into an unreadable five-line sliver jammed against the right edge, which makes the cluster look cluttered and the brand lockup illegible.
